blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Boxing legend, former senator, and antipoverty czar Manny Pacquiao took on an unusual trainee this week, giving Polish President Karol Nawrocki a boxing lesson during the latter’s state visit to the Philippines. Nawrocki had a sparring and training session with Pacquiao, with the eight-division world champion taking on the role of trainer. In a video posted by Pacquiao on his social media accounts on Wednesday, Nawrocki appeared excited and all smiles as he worked through the session under Pacquiao’s guidance.
